# FEAGI MCP tool index

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_skill_tool_index.py from server.py. Do not edit. -->

All 161 tools of the feagi MCP server, grouped by task. Tools marked
**Destructive** replace or remove structure: take a `snapshot_genome()` and confirm
with the user first. Use the task references for when and how to call each tool.

## Health and runtime diagnostics

- `health_check()`: Check FEAGI server connectivity and system health (GET /v1/system/health_check).
- `get_version_info()`: Get FEAGI runtime and component versions (GET /v1/system/versions).
- `get_runtime_metrics()`: Get comprehensive runtime metrics.
- `get_feagi_link_health()`: Get a compact FEAGI connectivity and registration health snapshot.
- `diagnose_feagi_runtime()`: Diagnose a dead or stalled FEAGI process without dumping logs.
- `get_last_failed_mutation()`: Most recent failed mutating FEAGI API request (`/v1/system/last_failed_mutation`).
- `get_log_tail()`: Recent FEAGI log records (`/v1/system/log_tail`).
- `get_controller_lifecycle_events()`: Read recent desktop/controller lifecycle events from runtime log files.
- `get_experiment_status()`: Whether an experiment is running in Neurorobotics Studio.
- `get_experiment_stop_cause()`: Infer likely experiment-stop cause from lifecycle event chronology.
- `check_live_state_drift()`: Report live brain state that no longer matches the genome or the controller.

## Genome, connectome, and snapshots

- `get_genome_info()`: Get metadata about the currently loaded genome.
- `get_genome_file_name()`: Current genome file label (GET genome/file_name).
- `download_genome()`: Download the complete genome configuration.
- `validate_genome()`: Validate a genome structure without uploading it.
- `upload_genome()`: Upload a new genome to FEAGI. **Destructive.**
- `load_genome_from_file()`: Load a `.genome` artifact into the live FEAGI. **Destructive.**
- `load_barebones_genome()`: Load the barebones genome (minimal FEAGI core areas only). **Destructive.**
- `save_genome_to_filesystem()`: Save the running genome to disk (POST genome/save), same as Brain Visualizer save.
- `download_region_genome()`: Download a brain-region subtree as a standalone genome JSON.
- `download_connectome()`: Save the running connectome to disk (GET /v1/connectome/download).
- `upload_connectome()`: Upload a saved `.connectome` file (POST /v1/connectome/upload). **Destructive.**
- `snapshot_genome()`: Save the running genome blueprint to disk under `label`.
- `list_genome_snapshots()`: List all genome snapshots stored on disk.
- `restore_genome_snapshot()`: Restore a previously saved genome snapshot via `POST /v1/genome/upload`. **Destructive.**
- `delete_genome_snapshot()`: Delete a stored genome snapshot by label. **Destructive.**
- `queue_amalgamation_by_payload()`: Queue an incoming genome for amalgamation (POST /v1/genome/amalgamation_by_payload).
- `confirm_amalgamation_destination()`: Complete a pending amalgamation (POST /v1/genome/amalgamation_destination).

## Brain regions (circuits)

- `get_brain_regions()`: List brain regions and member cortical areas (GET region/regions_members).
- `get_region_circuit()`: One brain region as a circuit: members, boundary inputs/outputs, and edges.
- `create_brain_region()`: Create a brain region (connectome hierarchy node; Brain Visualizer regional group).
- `validate_brain_region_hierarchy()`: Validate FEAGI brain-region hierarchy invariants used by Brain Visualizer.

## Cortical areas: find and inspect

- `list_cortical_areas()`: List cortical areas as compact catalog rows.
- `list_cortical_area_names()`: Get cortical area names, optionally filtered by substring.
- `resolve_cortical_area_by_name()`: Resolve a display name to base64 cortical_id (BV uses names; APIs use IDs).
- `get_cortical_id_name_mapping()`: Return {cortical_id: cortical_name} for all areas (GET cortical_id_name_mapping).
- `interpret_cortical_id()`: Decode an 8-byte FEAGI cortical ID without calling FEAGI (pure client-side).
- `explain_cortical_area_naming()`: Explain why a live cortical area has its title (compact, no registration dump).
- `inspect_cortical_area()`: Full cortical area record from connectome (POST cortical_area/cortical_area_properties).
- `inspect_cortical_areas_batch()`: Batch cortical area properties (POST multi/cortical_area_properties).
- `inspect_cortical_areas_minimal()`: Project `inspect_cortical_areas_batch` to a fixed, compact field set per area.
- `get_area_parameters()`: Neuron and geometry parameters for one cortical area.
- `get_area_semantic_info()`: Get detailed semantic information about a specific cortical area.
- `get_cortical_area_geometry()`: Get full geometry info for all cortical areas including dimensions and positions.

## Cortical areas: create and change

- `suggest_cortical_anchor_positions()`: Suggest 3D anchors for new CUSTOM/MEMORY cortical areas using BV placement rules.
- `create_cortical_area()`: Create a new cortical area programmatically.
- `update_cortical_area()`: Update properties of an existing cortical area.
- `clone_cortical_area()`: Clone a custom (c*) or memory (m*) cortical area (POST cortical_area/clone).
- `delete_cortical_area()`: Delete a cortical area and all its neurons/synapses. **Destructive.**
- `reset_cortical_neural_state()`: Reset runtime neural state for areas without changing genome (PUT cortical_area/reset).
- `reset_area_incoming_weights()`: Reset learned weights of ALL incoming mappings of each area (cortical_area/reset_weights). **Destructive.**
- `get_cortical_template()`: IPU/OPU cortical templates (GET genome/cortical_template), as in BV template picker.

## Input and output areas (IPU/OPU)

- `list_io_areas_compact()`: Compact IPU/OPU inventory: subtype, dimensions, `dev_count`, mismatch flag.
- `list_ipu_areas()`: List all IPU (Input Processing Unit) cortical area IDs.
- `list_ipu_areas_with_metadata()`: List all IPU areas with detailed semantic information.
- `list_opu_areas()`: List all OPU (Output Processing Unit) cortical area IDs.
- `list_opu_areas_with_metadata()`: List all OPU areas with detailed semantic information.
- `compute_io_cortical_id()`: Derive the canonical 8-byte IPU/OPU cortical id for a sensorimotor unit (no live call).
- `create_io_area_for_unit()`: Create the IPU/OPU area a sensorimotor unit binds to, with its canonical id derived.

## Connectivity: read

- `get_connectivity_summary()`: Tabular connectivity view: `[{src, dst, morphology, psc_mult, plasticity}]`.
- `get_connectivity()`: Get synaptic connectivity between two cortical areas.
- `get_cortical_mapping()`: Get stored mapping rules from the source area properties record.
- `get_cortical_map_detailed()`: Outgoing connectivity map per area (GET cortical_map_detailed).
- `trace_signal_path()`: Trace signal propagation path between cortical areas.
- `get_cortical_synapse_counts()`: Get incoming and outgoing synapse counts for a cortical area.
- `get_total_synapse_count()`: Get the brain's total synapse count (sum of incoming synapses over all areas).
- `list_area_synapses()`: Realized synapse topology for a cortical area (not morphology rules only).

## Connectivity: rules and wiring

- `describe_connectivity_rules()`: Return morphology catalog with explicit use-case guidance per rule.
- `recommend_connectivity_rules()`: Recommend existing morphology rules and a compact construction plan.
- `apply_connectivity_rule()`: Apply best matching existing rule directly to src->dst mapping.
- `propose_connectivity_rule()`: Author a compact connectivity rule before `create_morphology`.
- `build_reflex_mapping()`: Create a custom `patterns` morphology and wire src->dst with it in one call.
- `update_cortical_mapping()`: Create or update connections between two cortical areas.
- `delete_cortical_mapping()`: Delete all connections between two cortical areas. **Destructive.**
- `list_morphologies_summary()`: Slim morphology listing (name + type + class + pattern_count, paginated).
- `list_morphologies()`: Get all morphology definitions and connectivity rules.
- `get_morphology()`: Fetch one morphology by name (`POST /v1/morphology/morphology_properties`).
- `create_morphology()`: Create a custom morphology. Call `propose_connectivity_rule` first.
- `update_morphology()`: Replace an existing morphology (`PUT /v1/morphology/morphology`).
- `rename_morphology()`: Rename a custom morphology (connectivity rule).

## Memory and plasticity

- `get_memory_area_runtime_config()`: Get effective runtime lifecycle config for one memory cortical area.
- `set_memory_mp_encoding()`: Set how a memory area uses membrane potentials, and report what FEAGI runs.
- `list_memory_neurons()`: List runtime memory neurons in one memory cortical area.
- `inspect_memory_neuron()`: Inspect one memory neuron's lifecycle, identity, and realized synapses.
- `diagnose_memory_twin_mapping()`: Diagnose memory twin eligibility/status for one mapping pair.
- `diagnose_mapping_plasticity()`: Diagnose live plasticity state for one mapping pair.
- `watch_mapping_weights()`: Sample one mapping's synapse weights over time (series of min/max/avg and extremes).
- `freeze_mapping_plasticity()`: Stop (or resume) learning on one mapping while keeping its synapses and weights.
- `reset_mapping_weights()`: Reset one mapping's synapse weights to the rule's initial weight; clear plasticity traces. **Destructive.**
- `get_fire_ledger_areas_window_config()`: FireLedger per-area window configuration.

## Modulators

- `list_modulator_types()`: List the fixed modulator types.
- `list_modulators()`: List modulator instances in the loaded genome.
- `get_modulator()`: Read one modulator instance.
- `create_modulator()`: Create a modulator instance and its 1x1x1 driver area, or adopt an existing area.
- `update_modulator()`: Update a modulator instance. Type changes are rejected while subscribers exist.
- `rename_modulator()`: Rename a modulator and rewrite subscriber references.
- `modulator_usage()`: List areas and mapping rules subscribed to a modulator.
- `delete_modulator()`: Delete a modulator and its own driver; subscribers reject it unless forced. **Destructive.**
- `set_area_modulators()`: Replace the area-level modulator subscriptions (`neuro.*` kinds, and
- `unsubscribe_area_modulator()`: Remove one neuromodulator subscription from a cortical area.
- `set_mapping_modulators()`: Replace synaptic modulator subscriptions on the mapping from src to dst.
- `unsubscribe_mapping_modulator()`: Remove one synaptic modulator subscription from a mapping.

## Value planes and classifiers

- `list_classifiers()`: List first-class genome classifiers.
- `inspect_classifier()`: Inspect one classifier assembly in a single call.
- `create_classifier()`: Create a classifier with its memories, answer areas, and answer modulators.
- `update_classifier()`: Update a classifier record.
- `wire_value_passthrough()`: Wire a one-layer value plane 1:1 so each voxel's potential arrives exactly.
- `validate_magnitude_passthrough()`: Check that graded magnitudes in `src_area` reach `dst_area` unchanged.
- `expand_value_to_bins()`: Create a `W x H x levels` bin area driven by a one-layer value plane.
- `decode_class_map()`: Decode the last burst of a one-layer class map into class ids.
- `measure_audio_io_disparity()`: Measure the live gap between an audio input area and its audio output.

## Activity, stimulation, and neurons

- `probe_area_response()`: Force-fire one cortical area and measure whether a downstream area responds.
- `stimulate_area()`: Stimulate a cortical area for testing.
- `stimulate_area_batch()`: Stimulate many voxels in one cortical area in a single request.
- `run_stimulus_protocol()`: Present a timed stimulus sequence and record per-burst firing in one call.
- `monitor_activity()`: Monitor real-time neural activity, plus lifetime fire-count enrichment.
- `monitor_activity_batch()`: Monitor multiple cortical areas concurrently.
- `get_fire_queue_detailed()`: Get last-burst fire queue with neuron IDs per cortical area.
- `get_sensor_snapshot_last()`: Latest sensory input decoded by the burst loop (`/v1/input/sensor_snapshot/last`).
- `get_motor_snapshot_last()`: Latest motor output produced by the burst loop (`/v1/output/motor_snapshot/last`).
- `list_area_neuron_states()`: Compact neuron rows for one area: x/y/z, membrane potential, fire count.
- `inspect_neuron_state_at()`: Neuron runtime state at a voxel (`/v1/connectome/neuron_properties_at`).
- `get_neuron_state_by_id()`: Neuron runtime state by stable id (`/v1/connectome/neuron/{id}/properties`).
- `get_voxel_neurons()`: All neurons + synapses at a voxel (`/v1/cortical_area/voxel_neurons`).

## Burst engine

- `get_burst_engine_status()`: Get burst engine runtime status.
- `get_burst_engine_config()`: Burst engine config (`/v1/burst_engine/config`).
- `get_burst_counter()`: Current burst counter (`/v1/burst_engine/burst_counter`).
- `control_burst_engine()`: Burst engine control (`POST /v1/burst_engine/control`).
- `pause_burst_engine()`: Hold (pause) the burst engine (`POST /v1/burst_engine/hold`).
- `resume_burst_engine()`: Resume the burst engine after a hold (`POST /v1/burst_engine/resume`).
- `set_burst_engine_frequency()`: Set the running brain's burst frequency. This call is the whole change.

## Agents and embodiment

- `get_registered_agents()`: Get list of all registered agents and their subscriptions (agent registry).
- `get_agent_liveness()`: How close each registered agent is to being deregistered for inactivity.
- `get_agent_properties()`: Get detailed properties for a specific registered agent.
- `get_motor_group_summary()`: Compact motor bundle titles, unit ids, and channel counts for an agent.
- `get_agent_joint_map()`: Get a focused actuator-to-OPU mapping for a registered agent.
- `get_agent_device_registrations()`: Get device registrations for an agent showing motor/sensor structure.
- `list_agent_capabilities_all()`: Raw multi-agent capabilities payload (`/v1/agent/capabilities/all`).
- `compare_device_registration_store()`: Compare session vs descriptor device-registration stores (compact).
- `get_agent_connection_endpoints()`: Get the live FEAGI agent connection endpoints (ZMQ/WebSocket) and burst rate.
- `send_motor_command()`: Drive a specific robot joint to a target angle/position via OPU stimulation.
- `auto_polarity_probe()`: Empirically discover OPU column -> sensor direction by force-firing each column.
- `list_controller_bridges()`: List all active controller bridges (xARM, MuJoCo, ROS2, etc.) discovered on this machine.
- `get_embodiment_status()`: Get status of connected embodiment controllers (GET /v1/embodiment/status when available).
- `embodiment_discover_introspection_endpoint()`: Locate a controller's introspection HTTP endpoint via the launcher descriptor.
- `embodiment_get_physics_state()`: GET ground-truth physics state from an embodiment controller.
- `embodiment_measure_bodies()`: Read tilt, height and contacts of named bodies from the MuJoCo controller (read-only).
- `embodiment_set_joint_state()`: Place embodiment joints deterministically (e.g. tilt pendulum, position arm).
- `embodiment_reset_simulation_time_stats()`: Reset the session max simulation clock (benchmark high-water mark).
- `measure_balance()`: Balance outcome numbers from the simulator: episodes, upright time, tilt, falls.
- `record_aligned_trace()`: One timeline pairing each sampled burst with the simulator's physics at that moment.

## MuJoCo scene and simulator packs

- `get_mujoco_scene_config()`: Read the live MuJoCo settings: safety boundary, objects, cameras, embodiment, feedback, rate.
- `configure_mujoco_scene()`: Apply one MuJoCo settings action on the running controller.
- `add_mujoco_scene_object()`: Add one primitive to the running MuJoCo scene without removing the others.
- `set_mujoco_safety_boundary()`: Turn the Cartesian safety box on or off in the running MuJoCo scene.
- `composer_list_simulator_packs()`: Query Composer public catalog of shared simulator asset packs (GCS-backed).
- `composer_get_simulator_pack_versions()`: List semver versions indexed for `pack_id` on Composer.
- `composer_get_simulator_pack_resolved()`: Resolved pack manifest with per-file HTTPS URLs (include.xml, LICENSE, etc.).
- `composer_download_simulator_pack_bundle()`: Download every file listed in the resolved manifest into `output_directory`.

## Brain Visualizer API pass-through

- `list_brain_visualizer_operations()`: List every Brain Visualizer REST operation (operation_id, method, path, description).
- `brain_visualizer_api()`: Invoke any whitelisted Brain Visualizer FEAGI API operation.

## Studio-only tools (neurorobotics-studio server; present only when Studio is connected)

- `read_design_notebook(view?, kinds?, since?, query?, limit?)`: the experiment's design notebook; the default view is a digest of goal, constraints, baseline, open hypotheses, dead ends and recent entries.
- `append_design_note(kind, title, body?, metrics?, status?, refs?, amends?, tags?)`: adds one entry (goal, constraint, baseline, hypothesis, change, measurement, verdict, dead_end, idea, gap).
